args.title: Juniper Labware: Warehouse Automation in 2026 — Summary
args.body:
• Newsletter: Juniper Labware's latest newsletter features "Warehouse automation in 2026," linking to a blog article and offering matching case studies to readers on an active project.
• Article: In 2026, warehouse pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece: The biggest saving from warehouse automation was fewer mis-picks.
